integrity: Analytical theorem with finite formula tests; independent validation has not been conducted.
scientific_limitations: Positive-diagonal symmetric congruences on real SPD star matrices, fixed dimension and singular correlation limit; exact-arithmetic theorem only. Does not cover one-sided SPAI, Cholesky FSAI or arbitrary graphs. Earlier equivalent calculations remain possible.
title: A quadratic conditioning penalty from Frobenius-optimal diagonal congruence on positive-definite stars
